subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Exporting intensity values from SNP chip

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Exporting intensity values from SNP chip
parts:
Hi "CK",

On Fri, Feb 1, 2013 at 6:56 AM, <ahke...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi,
>
> i am a new user of aroma.affymetrix , can I know how do one export
> intensity values from all the samples into matrix form? ( i have 57 CEL
> files), since i would like to use those to perform pca and check for batch
> effect.

If you wish to get the K ***probe intensities*** across the I=57 CEL
files as a KxI matrix, you can do:

dataSet <- "MyDataSet";
chipType <- "GenomeWideSNP_6";
csR <- AffymetrixCelSet$byName(dataSet, chipType=chipType);

Y <- extractMatrix(dsR)

But be aware that this loads all data into memory and if you're
working with GenomeWideSNP_6 arrays each arrays occupies about 55Mb of
RAM. So, with 57 arrays, you need ~3 GB of RAM to just hold the data.
If you then start manipulating it, you'll quickly generate some
copies of this object. Also, this doesn't scale well if you get more
and more samples over time.

Note also that the probe intensities 'Y' has no information about
which probes belongs to which SNPs and which allele etc. There are
also probes from non-polymorphic CN loci etc in 'Y'. So, doing PCA
and similar things on plain probe signals is not going to do "magic"
out of the box.

If you wish to extract normalized and probe-summarized signals (e.g.
after CRMAv2), that can also be done.

/Henrik
